meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 该技能把你的助手接入微软 Teams：加入所需代码并通过检查后，引导你登录微软账号、创建机器人、保存配置、生成安装链接，把 Teams 频道、群聊或私聊的对话接到助手，并让机器人能向选定用户发私聊消息。
howto.when: 当用户要求给系统接入微软 Teams 频道或开始 Teams 集成时触发。

say.text: 帮我把微软 Teams 接入进来。
say.note: Claude 会开始接入流程并要求你提供微软账号。

say.text: 给助手添加 Teams 频道支持。
say.note: 需要你准备微软账号和公网 HTTPS 地址。

say.text: 配置 Teams 机器人与我的账号直连。
say.note: Claude 会创建机器人并生成安装链接。

howto.what_en: Adds Teams chat via the Chat SDK: works in channels, group chats, and DMs. It adds code, runs checks, walks through Microsoft sign-in and bot creation, saves credentials, gives an install link, and wires the bot to DM a chosen user.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to add Microsoft Teams channel support or to set up Teams integration for the assistant.

say_en.text: Add Microsoft Teams to our assistant.
say_en.note: Claude will run the integration flow and ask for your Microsoft account.

say_en.text: Give the assistant Teams channel support.
say_en.note: You'll need a Microsoft account and a public HTTPS URL.

say_en.text: Set up a Teams bot and connect it to my account.
say_en.note: Claude creates the bot and returns an install link.
